files.note: The region of the approved iPhone home capture (arrive p-home and phone3 c-home, crop mw-tall.jpg 780 by 1688), found by normalised cross-correlation on luminance at 0.944 (.lanetools/match_tall.py): left 0.3853, top 0.0013, 0.2301 of the width, 0.9959 of the height. The app darkens it toward the bottom as the capture does; nothing else is changed.
